name: Andre Bell
occupation: Patrol officer with a traffic assignment
life: Andre knew half the city's cabs by their rear lights before he could spell dispatch. On a beat he still catches himself thinking of drivers as a boy grateful for a ride instead of an officer obliged to take their details. On Sunday, near Paper & Pine Books, Andre starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: He once drove my mother to hospital and refused a fare. I am the one who took the report on his last scrape. I offered to stand at the crossing in ordinary clothes when he goes by.
appearance: Andre has a high puff tied with plain cord, a wide brow and a narrow jaw, and a favorite piece of clothing, a cream pullover. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Andre leans a shoulder against the wall during long conversations.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Andre takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To give Saul the courtesy of an ordinary goodbye at the crossing.
family: Noel Gomes is Andre’s second cousin. Andre offers the first invitation. Noel gets to change the plan. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The boy on the corner*, Noel says, “I watched the little brother for grocery money.”
connections: Hana Solberg. One remembers being given a lift in a crisis. The other wants this final lift to include the view at the bridge crest.

reactions.situation: The old driver wants to change the farewell route
reactions.response: Andre takes the changed route seriously and checks who needs to know the new return time.

reactions.situation: A street musician can't finish a familiar song
reactions.response: Andre offers a little space from the crowd and waits for the player to indicate whether company is wanted.

reactions.situation: When a relative dismisses a little luxury
reactions.response: Andre asks which ordinary pleasure the relative would give up first.
